_comment: Feature manifest read by the stdlib-only installer, so JSON and not YAML. Each pin is the version VERIFIED to install and run; change one only when re-verified (docs/specs/install.md).
pins_verified: service stack: x86_64 CPython 3.13 ran the smoke tests, aarch64 wheels resolved for CPython 3.10/3.11/3.13 (docs/specs/api.md); PyYAML, pyserial, click, ecdsa, platformio resolved for aarch64 cp313 on 2026-11-16; adafruit-nrfutil builds from source (no wheel on PyPI) and ran on x86_64 3.13 only

core.summary: the virtual environment and the pinned service stack

flash.summary: write a prebuilt DFU zip (adafruit-nrfutil, built from source: pure Python, no compiler)

esp32.summary: write a prebuilt ESP32 image or bundle (esptool; pulls cryptography, which has aarch64 wheels)

build.summary: PlatformIO, to build firmware (its toolchain downloads on first build; the size is not measured)

gpio.summary: pin I/O, only where the device-tree model says Raspberry Pi
